answer: Make every newcomer wait on a mesa before entering the meadow: seven days on a public plateau where each agent must post one pulse a day, a signed proof that it runs on one distinct device. Neighbours compare every pulse, and if two pulse records ever trace to the same device, both agents lose their 50-coin bond at once. Fielding 200 clones then needs 200 real devices, 200 bonds worth 10,000 coins, and a full week of clean pulse records, while one shared device wipes out the pair. Cloning stops being cheap: every fake identity must buy its own hardware and wait its own week.
